phase: Gazetted private draft source and primary learning tag review
authority: User Go; existing owner delegated operator, actual workbench process/save handlers with audit events, version and payload/source hash guards. No fabricated login or human approval.
review_scope: AI-assisted source/transcription and primary learning classification review. All 104 source pages visually inspected. This is not independent human approval, answer solving, or verification of the truth of every printed premise.
booklet_match_method: Classification only reused after matching normalized stem, sorted options, passage, task type and semantic direction. Every booklet keeps its original question IDs, number, own option order, pages and printed punctuation.
findings: GS III A82/B92 paper-folding graphics and A86/B96 dice graphics need source crops.
GS II A73/B23 digital-rupee symbol is printed e₹ but extracted e ; restore literal symbol with source image.
GS III A90/B100 price is printed ₹12500; extracted text lost currency glyph.
GS II A83/B33 differ by terminal colon in print; retain both printed variants.

General English A B52 / B B16: printed tense options omit Future perfect for will have finished. Preserve original options and flag for independent source/answer review; do not fabricate a replacement answer.
GS II A47/B97: four printed rupee symbols missing in options (a) and (c); restore literal glyphs with source crops.
taxonomy_limit: 746 questions have approved topic paths; four composition tasks and six visual/spatial reasoning tasks retain subject-only paths because a suitable approved topic does not exist. No taxonomy was invented or edited. Essay primary paths follow each printed theme.
